text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Huff, puff, huff...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Pant... Pant... Dia... You really are catching up!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I could practically feel your
determination. I'm
still getting
goosebumps.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
It was the same for me. I felt like I was
going to
be consumed by your fiery
spirit.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: So that's what you're like in a real race!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: And that's what you're like in a real race!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
We can face each other like this again
and again!
I can't wait!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
That's right! We can race each other as
many
times as we want!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Way to go, Kitasan! I'll be rooting for
you in the
next race too!

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text: We'll be rooting for you too, Diamond!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, everyone! My next race is...
the Osaka
Hai!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ooohhh!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Does that mean she's going for the
Senior Spring
Triple Crown?! Go get it,
Kitasan!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I will! And I hope you'll all be there
watching!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I'm going to run in the Osaka Hai too!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We still haven't discussed the plan for
her senior
year yet, let alone her next
race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond quickly glances in my
direction
before turning back to the
stands and repeating
herself.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to run against Kita in the
Osaka Hai!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
The rivalry between Satono Diamond
and Kitasan
Black continues!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
The Arima Kinen was only the
beginning... Wooo!
I'll be there to watch
the next one!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Cheers erupt from the stands and things
show no sign of calming down. Kitasan
Black then invites
the other racers to
come together.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume stand in a line and look
up at
the stands. They raise their hands
and wave to the
spectators.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Here's to another great year! Hope to
see you all
again!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...I'm sorry for not consulting with you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As soon as we make it back to the
waiting room,
Satono Diamond bows
deeply in apology.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's no problem with the distance or
timing of the race. I just need to make
sure this aligns with her dream of
becoming an illustrious
Umamusume.
choice_data_list: Are you sure you want the Osaka Ha...
Are you sure you want the Osaka Ha...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes. The Osaka Hai is a G1 race, so I
don't see
any problem with it.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
When I saw Kita after the race today... I
realized
yet again how amazing she is.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I'm still nowhere near close to catching
up to
her...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
You saw how the crowd was smiling,
didn't you?
You heard the roar of their
cheers.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Kita's running brings excitement to the
Twinkle
Series. Everyone loves watching
her.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I feel like that's part of being an
illustrious
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
To tell the truth, I still don't quite
understand
what exactly an illustrious
runner is supposed to
be like.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
In Kita's case, maybe it's that special
something
about her when she runs that
makes people want
to cheer her on.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Her style of running has the ability to
draw fans in
and captivate them.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...I don't think I could induce the same
kind of
wild enthusiasm as a daughter of
the Satono
family.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her will is strong and unwavering. She's
always
noble and never shows weakness.
choice_data_list: Dia has her own unique strengths.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's frustrating that those qualities
essentially mask her efforts. She shines
magnificently, and is
no less impressive
than Kitasan Black.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Thanks for saying so... But I'm
okay.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to find out what being
illustrious means
to me.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
How can I contribute to the Umamusume
world as
Satono Diamond?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I feel like if I continue to watch and
chase after
Kita, I'll be able to figure out
my own path.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Okay! Let's do it!
choice_data_list: Understood. Next is the Osaka Hai!
Understood. Next is the Osaka Hai,...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Still searching for an answer to what it
means to
be illustrious, Satono Diamond
forges ahead into
her senior year.
